title: geneviewer chart spec, version 1
description: What newChart() draws. Each top-level key is a GC_* function of the R package, each property one of its arguments in camelCase; see schema/NAMING.md.

version.description: The spec version. Optional: a spec without one is version 1.

data.description: The genes: an array of rows, or columns (an object of equal-length arrays), as R and Python send them.

fields.description: The columns of data that hold each gene's position, cluster, group and strand.

start.description: Column with the start position of each gene.

end.description: Column with the end position of each gene.

cluster.description: Column that splits the genes into clusters. Default: one cluster.

group.description: Column that groups the genes, which sets their colours and the legend.

strand.description: Column with the strand of each gene: 1, "forward", "sense" or "+" for forward; -1, 0, "reverse", "antisense", "complement" or "-" for reverse. Default: a column named strand if the data has one; otherwise a gene with start less than end is forward and any other gene is reverse.

width.description: Width of the chart: pixels, or a CSS length such as "100%".

height.description: Height of the chart: pixels, or a CSS length such as "400px".

style.description: CSS styles of the chart's element, e.g. { backgroundColor: "white" }.

cluster.description: Layout of the genes in a cluster: strands on separate rows, overlapping genes on separate tracks, and the cluster's style. An array of entries applies them in order; an entry with clusters only to those clusters.

clusterTitle.description: Title and subtitle above each cluster. An array of entries applies them in order; an entry with clusters only to those clusters.

clusterLabel.description: Label in the left or right margin of each cluster. An array of entries applies them in order; an entry with clusters only to those clusters.

clusterFooter.description: Footer below each cluster: a title and subtitle. An array of entries applies them in order; an entry with clusters only to those clusters.

color.description: Colours of the gene groups, for the genes and the legend.

coordinates.description: Start and end positions written at the genes. An array of entries applies them in order; an entry with clusters only to those clusters.

elementStyle.description: Overrides for single elements: a gene, label or coordinate, a title or subtitle, a legend label or marker, a scale bar or axis. Each entry is one element; later entries for the same element add to earlier ones.

events.description: Which interactions the chart reports, and whether parts are clickable.

genes.description: The gene markers. An array of entries applies them in order; an entry with clusters only to those clusters.

grid.description: Size and margins of each cluster, and the direction clusters are laid out in. An array of entries applies them in order; an entry with clusters only to those clusters.

labels.description: Labels of the genes. An array of entries applies them in order; an entry with clusters only to those clusters.

legend.description: The legend of the gene groups.

links.description: Links between genes of different clusters, drawn from a table of pairs. An array of entries applies them in order; an entry with clusters only to those clusters.

pattern.description: Pattern fills of the genes, exons and legend markers by group, e.g. for black and white figures.

scale.description: The position scale of each cluster: its range, axis and scale breaks. An array of entries applies them in order; an entry with clusters only to those clusters.

scaleBar.description: A scale bar in each cluster. An array of entries applies them in order; an entry with clusters only to those clusters.

sequence.description: The line the genes sit on, with marks at scale breaks. An array of entries applies them in order; an entry with clusters only to those clusters.

theme.description: The default look of every part of the chart. A built-in theme's name, or an object that starts from one and changes it. Options set in the other components take precedence.

toolbar.description: The chart's own buttons: undo, redo, reset, reset zoom and save.

tooltip.description: The tooltip shown over a gene. An array of entries applies them in order; an entry with clusters only to those clusters.

trackMouse.description: Shows the position under the mouse, e.g. to place annotations. An array of entries applies them in order; an entry with clusters only to those clusters.

transcript.description: Transcripts: exons, introns and UTRs. An array of entries applies them in order; an entry with selection only to those transcripts.

zoom.description: A slider below the clusters to zoom in on part of them.

annotation.description: Annotations drawn in the clusters: text, lines, arrows, symbols and more.

align.description: Aligns the clusters on one gene: each cluster's scale is set so the gene is at the same place in every cluster.

clusterRef.description: A cluster: its name, or its 1-based position.

column.description: The name of a column of the data.

colors.description: Colours: one colour, an array recycled over the groups, or an object of colours by group.

style.description: Styles as in R: CSS-like keys in camelCase (fill, fontSize, ...) and their values.

itemStyle.description: Styles of single items, each with the item's 0-based index in its cluster.

groupStyle.description: Styles by group: an object of style objects, keyed by group value.

data.description: Table data: an array of rows, or columns (an object of equal-length arrays).

separateStrands.description: Whether forward and reverse genes go on separate rows.

strandSpacing.description: Space between the forward and reverse rows, with separateStrands.

preventGeneOverlap.description: Overlapping genes go on separate tracks: true for all overlapping genes, "nested" only for genes that lie inside another gene. The track of each gene is in its geneTrack field.

overlapMin.description: How much two genes must overlap to go on separate tracks: base pairs, or a share of the shorter gene such as "10%". Default: any overlap.

clusters.description: The clusters this entry applies to, by name or 1-based position. Default: all clusters.

style.description: CSS styles of the cluster's element.

margin.description: Margins of the cluster, in pixels.

clusterEntry.description: Other properties are passed to the renderer as they are.

title.description: Title of each cluster; an array is recycled over the clusters.

subtitle.description: Subtitle of each cluster; an array is recycled over the clusters.

clusters.description: The clusters this entry applies to, by name or 1-based position. Default: all clusters.

align.description: Alignment of the title and subtitle; x moves them from there. Default: the theme's, otherwise "center".

spacing.description: Pixels between the title and subtitle. Default: the theme's, otherwise 20.

x.description: Horizontal offset of the title, in pixels.

y.description: Vertical offset of the title, in pixels.

clusterTitleEntry.description: Other properties are passed to the renderer as they are.

title.description: Text of the label; an array is recycled over the clusters.

width.description: Width of the label, which sets the cluster's margin on that side. Default: a margin set with grid, otherwise the theme's, otherwise "100px".

clusters.description: The clusters this entry applies to, by name or 1-based position. Default: all clusters.

position.description: Side of the label. Default: the theme's, otherwise "left".

align.description: Alignment of the label's lines in its margin; x moves it from there. Default: the theme's, otherwise "center".

wrapLabel.description: Whether long labels wrap over several lines. Default: the theme's, otherwise true.

subtitle.description: A second line below the title, e.g. the species.

subtitleFont.description: Font options of the subtitle. Default: 11px, not bold.

spacing.description: Pixels between the middle of the title's last line and the subtitle. Default: the theme's, otherwise 1.2 times the mean font size of the two.

x.description: Horizontal offset of the label, in pixels.

y.description: Vertical offset of the label, in pixels.

clusterLabelEntry.description: Other properties are passed to the renderer as they are.

title.description: Title of each footer; an array is recycled over the clusters.

clusters.description: The clusters this entry applies to, by name or 1-based position. Default: all clusters.

align.description: Alignment of the title and subtitle; x moves them from there. Default: the theme's, otherwise "left".

spacing.description: Pixels between the title and subtitle. Default: the theme's, otherwise 12.

x.description: Horizontal offset of the footer, in pixels.

y.description: Vertical offset of the footer, in pixels.

clusterFooterEntry.description: Other properties are passed to the renderer as they are.

colorScheme.description: Name of a colour scheme: a D3 scheme such as "schemeTableau10", or a geneviewer palette such as "okabeIto".

customColors.description: Colours of the groups: an array recycled over the groups, or an object of colours by group. Groups left out keep the colours of colorScheme, the theme's palette or the defaults.

tickValuesTop.description: Positions written above the cluster, in place of the genes' own.

tickValuesBottom.description: Positions written below the cluster, in place of the genes' own.

ticksFormat.description: D3 number format of the positions. Default: ",.0f".

clusters.description: The clusters this entry applies to, by name or 1-based position. Default: all clusters.

groupStyle.description: Styles by group, for the coordinates of every gene of that group: show = false leaves them out, tick styles their ticks, the rest their text.

styleBy.description: Column whose values groupStyle matches. Default: fields.group.

rotate.description: Rotation of the coordinates, in degrees.

yPositionTop.description: Vertical position of the coordinates above the genes, from 1 (bottom) to 100 (top) of the cluster.

yPositionBottom.description: Vertical position of the coordinates below the genes, from 1 (bottom) to 100 (top) of the cluster.

overlapThreshold.description: Distance in pixels below which coordinates of neighbouring genes go on the other side.

coordinatesEntry.description: Other properties are passed to the renderer as they are.

rowID.description: For genes, labels and coordinates: the gene's rowID, as reported in select and dblclick events.

cluster.description: For cluster titles, footers, labels, scale bars and axes: the cluster's name or 1-based position.

part.description: For titles, footers and cluster labels: "title" or "subtitle"; for the legend: "label" or "marker".

end.description: For coordinates: the start or end coordinate. Default: both.

group.description: For the legend: the group's original value, as reported in events.

elementStyleEntry.description: One element's override. The other properties are the element's options under their JavaScript names: fill, stroke, fontSize, text, moveX, moveY, show and so on.

click.description: Whether clicks are reported, in a spec with an events key; a spec without one reports nothing.

highlight.description: Whether the part under the mouse is outlined, to show what a click selects.

rendered.description: Whether each finished draw is reported as a rendered event.

renderId.description: Identifies this draw in the rendered event. A new value also restarts the zoom at its range. Default: a new unique id for each draw.

dblclick.description: Whether double-clicks are reported, for editing.

legendClick.description: Whether clicks on the legend are reported.

drag.description: Whether labels, titles, scale bars, axes and legend items can be dragged. Moves can be undone and redone.

zoom.description: Whether the zoom window is reported, on the first draw and after every change.

group.description: Column that groups the genes for their colours. Default: fields.group.

colorScheme.description: Colour scheme of the groups. Default: the colours of the color component.

customColors.description: Colours of the groups: an array recycled over the groups, or an object by group.

clusters.description: The clusters this entry applies to, by name or 1-based position. Default: all clusters.

itemStyle.description: Styles of single genes, by their 0-based index in the cluster.

groupStyle.description: Styles by group, for every gene of that group. A gene's itemStyle takes precedence.

styleBy.description: Column whose values groupStyle matches, or "geneTrack" for the track of each gene. Default: group.

cornerRadius.description: Radius in pixels of the markers' corners. Default: sharp, and 5 for "rbox".

x.description: Horizontal offset of the genes, in pixels.

y.description: Vertical position of the genes, from 1 (bottom) to 100 (top) of the cluster.

strokeWidth.description: Outline width of the genes, in pixels.

arrowheadWidth.description: Width of the arrowhead, in pixels. Default: from markerSize.

arrowheadHeight.description: Height of the arrowhead, in pixels. Default: from markerSize.

markerHeight.description: Height of the gene body, in pixels. Default: from markerSize.

genesEntry.description: Other properties are passed to the renderer as they are.

margin.description: Margins of the cluster in pixels.

width.description: Width of the cluster; a number is a percentage.

direction.description: Clusters below each other ("column") or side by side ("row").

clusters.description: The clusters this entry applies to, by name or 1-based position. Default: all clusters.

label.description: Column with the label of each gene. Default: fields.group.

clusters.description: The clusters this entry applies to, by name or 1-based position. Default: all clusters.

itemStyle.description: Styles of single labels, by their 0-based index in the cluster.

groupStyle.description: Styles by group, for the labels of every gene of that group.

styleBy.description: Column whose values groupStyle matches, e.g. the label column, or "geneTrack". Default: fields.group.

x.description: Horizontal offset of the labels, in pixels.

y.description: Vertical position of the labels, from 1 (bottom) to 100 (top) of the cluster.

dx.description: Horizontal shift of each label, e.g. "0.5em".

dy.description: Vertical shift of each label, e.g. "-1em".

rotate.description: Rotation of the labels, in degrees.

start.description: Position where the labels start; labels of genes before it are not drawn.

end.description: Position where the labels end; labels of genes after it are not drawn.

adjustLabels.description: Overlapping labels: true moves them apart, "hide" hides them, "spread" spreads them out with leader lines, false leaves them.

spreadPosition.description: With adjustLabels "spread": the side of the genes the labels go to.

leaderLine.description: Style of the lines to spread labels (stroke, strokeWidth, length in pixels); false draws none.

textAnchor.description: Text alignment of each label at its gene.

labelAdjustment.description: How overlapping labels are moved: rotation, offsetX, offsetY, dx, dy.

labelsEntry.description: Other properties are passed to the renderer as they are.

group.description: Column whose values the legend lists. Default: fields.group.

backgroundColor.description: Background colour; style.backgroundColor takes precedence. Default: the theme's, otherwise transparent.

order.description: Order of the groups in the legend.

position.description: Above or below the clusters. Default: the theme's, otherwise "bottom".

align.description: Alignment of the legend items; each row on its own. Default: the theme's, otherwise "left".

style.description: CSS styles of the legend's element.

markerStyle.description: Options of the legend items (markers), such as cursor.

textStyle.description: Options of the legend text, such as fontSize.

cornerRadius.description: Radius in pixels of the markers' corners. Default: square.

groupStyle.description: Styles by group for the text of that group's entry; styles under marker go to its marker.

x.description: Horizontal offset of the legend, in pixels.

y.description: Vertical offset of the legend, in pixels.

width.description: Width of the legend. Default: the chart's width.

orientation.description: Entries side by side or below each other.

adjustHeight.description: Whether the legend's height follows its entries.

legendEntry.description: Other properties are passed to the renderer as they are.

data.description: The links: one row per pair, made by R or Python (get_links) or by hand.

group.description: The column the genes were matched on (R and Python: get_links). Its values pick the genes labelled with the measure; without it, links.data was given and labelPosition "gene" draws no labels.

value1.description: Values of group matched in the first cluster of each pair; only their genes are labelled with the measure.

value2.description: Values of group matched in the second cluster of each pair; only their genes are labelled with the measure.

clusters.description: The clusters this entry applies to, by name or 1-based position. Default: all clusters.

curve.description: Whether links are curved. Default: the theme's, otherwise true.

measure.description: The measure that sets the links' colour.

label.description: Whether to write the measure on the links.

labelPosition.description: Where the measure goes: with the gene's label ("gene") or in the middle of the link ("link").

normalColor.description: Colour of links. Default: the theme's, otherwise "#969696".

invertedColor.description: Colour of inverted links. Default: the theme's, otherwise "#d62728".

lowColor.description: Colour links fade to at a low measure. Default: the theme's, otherwise white.

vmin.description: Measure of the lightest colour, and the low end of the colour bar. Default: the theme's, otherwise 0.

vmax.description: Measure of the full colour, and the high end of the colour bar. Default: the theme's, otherwise 100.

useGroupColors.description: Whether links take the colour of their group.

colorBar.description: Whether to show the colour bar. Default: the theme's, otherwise true.

colorBarOptions.description: Options of the colour bar: position, orientation, labels, x, y, width, height, title and its styles.

linkWidth.description: Width of the links: 1 is the full width of the genes, 0 none.

labelStyle.description: CSS styles of the measure labels.

y.description: Vertical position of the links, from 1 (bottom) to 100 (top) of the cluster.

labelAdjustment.description: How overlapping measures on the links are moved: rotation, offsetX, offsetY, dx, dy.

linksEntry.description: Other properties are passed to the renderer as they are.

patterns.description: Pattern names: an array recycled over the groups, or an object by group (groups left out get none). Default: a pattern for each group in a fixed order.

color.description: Colour of the pattern: one colour, an array recycled over the groups, or an object by group.

background.description: Colour behind the pattern, in the same forms as color; null keeps the gene colours.

size.description: Width and height of one pattern tile in pixels.

strokeWidth.description: Width of the pattern lines in pixels.

clusters.description: The clusters this entry applies to, by name or 1-based position. Default: all clusters.

start.description: Start of the scale. Default: the first gene's start, less padding.

end.description: End of the scale. Default: the last gene's end, plus padding.

padding.description: Room on either side: a number, or a share such as "2%". Default: the theme's, otherwise 2.

breaks.description: Stretches of the scale left out, with break marks on the line, in the data's positions.

tickValues.description: Positions of the ticks. Default: chosen by D3.

reverse.description: Whether the scale runs from right to left.

axisPosition.description: Axis above or below the genes. Default: the theme's, otherwise "bottom".

axisType.description: Whether ticks show positions, or the range from the scale's start.

y.description: Vertical position of the axis, from 1 to 100.

autoBreaks.description: Whether to add scale breaks at large gaps between genes.

autoBreakThreshold.description: Gaps larger than this percentage of the cluster become scale breaks, with autoBreaks.

breakPadding.description: Room left on either side of a break: a percentage of the region shown, or base pairs as a string such as "500bp".

ticksCount.description: Number of ticks. Default: the theme's, otherwise 10.

ticksFormat.description: D3 number format of the ticks. Default: ",.0f" for positions, ".2s" for ranges.

scaleEntry.description: The other properties are further options under their JavaScript names, as R passes them through `...`.

show.description: Whether to show the scale bar.

clusters.description: The clusters this entry applies to, by name or 1-based position. Default: all clusters.

unit.description: Length of the scale bar, in base pairs.

x.description: Horizontal offset of the scale bar, in pixels.

y.description: Vertical offset of the scale bar, in pixels.

textPadding.description: Space between the text and the bar, in pixels.

scaleBarEntry.description: Other properties are passed to the renderer as they are.

clusters.description: The clusters this entry applies to, by name or 1-based position. Default: all clusters.

y.description: Vertical position of the line. Default: the theme's, otherwise 50.

markerStyle.description: Styles of the break marks, plus markerHeight, tiltAmount and gap.

start.description: Position where the line starts. Default: the scale's start.

end.description: Position where the line ends. Default: the scale's end.

sequenceEntry.description: Other properties are passed to the renderer as they are.

base.description: The built-in theme to start from; R's list of theme settings is the theme object itself. Default: the current theme.

textScale.description: Text size as a factor of the default font sizes.

lineColor.description: Colour of the lines: sequence, axis, coordinates, scale bar and leader lines.

background.description: Background colour of the chart, also the fill of UTRs.

palette.description: Gene colours: a colour scheme's name or an array of colours, in the order of the groups.

pattern.description: Patterns, with the properties of the pattern component; false removes the theme's patterns.

themeEntry.description: Theme settings. The other properties are options per component, named after the component and with the component's option names (e.g. labels: { fontSize: "10px" }, legend: { textStyle: { fill: "grey" } }).

style.description: CSS styles of the title's element.

height.description: Height of the title. Default: the theme's, otherwise 50 pixels with a subtitle and 40 without.

align.description: Alignment of the title and subtitle. Default: the theme's, otherwise "center".

spacing.description: Pixels between the title and subtitle. Default: the theme's, otherwise 20.

x.description: Horizontal offset of the title, in pixels.

y.description: Vertical offset of the title, in pixels.

titleEntry.description: Other properties are passed to the renderer as they are.

position.description: The corner of the toolbar. Default: "topright".

buttons.description: The buttons, in their order. Default: all.

size.description: Size of the icons in pixels. Default: 20.

hoverColor.description: Colour of an icon under the mouse. Default: "#555555".

tooltipBackground.description: Background of the tooltips and the save menu. Default: "#333333".

tooltipColor.description: Text colour of the tooltips and the menu. Default: "white".

tooltipBorder.description: CSS border of the tooltips and the menu. Default: none.

tooltipRadius.description: Corner radius of the tooltips and the menu. Default: 3.

tooltipShadow.description: CSS box shadow of the tooltips and the menu. Default: none.

fontFamily.description: Font of the tooltips and the menu. Default: Arial.

icons.description: Icons by button, as Font Awesome names, e.g. { save: "camera" }. Buttons left out keep theirs.

formatter.description: HTML of the tooltip; {column} is replaced by the gene's value.

clusters.description: The clusters this entry applies to, by name or 1-based position. Default: all clusters.

triggers.description: The parts that show the tooltip.

opacity.description: Opacity of the tooltip when hidden.

tooltipEntry.description: Other properties are passed to the renderer as they are.

clusters.description: The clusters this entry applies to, by name or 1-based position. Default: all clusters.

trackMouseEntry.description: Other properties are passed to the renderer as they are.

transcript.description: Column that groups the rows into transcripts.

type.description: Column with the feature type of each row ("exon", "intron", "UTR").

strand.description: Column with the strand of each transcript, read as fields.strand.

group.description: Column that groups the transcripts for their colours.

colorScheme.description: Colour scheme of the groups. Default: the colours of the color component.

customColors.description: Colours of the groups: an array recycled over the groups, or an object by group.

itemStyleExons.description: Styles of single exons, by 0-based index.

itemStyleIntrons.description: Styles of single introns, by 0-based index.

itemStyleUTRs.description: Styles of single UTRs, by 0-based index.

groupStyleExons.description: Styles by group, for every exon of that group.

groupStyleIntrons.description: Styles by group, for every intron of that group.

groupStyleUTRs.description: Styles by group, for every UTR of that group.

styleBy.description: Column whose values the group styles match. Default: group.

x.description: Horizontal offset of the transcripts, in pixels.

y.description: Vertical position of the transcripts, from 1 (bottom) to 100 (top) of the cluster.

transcriptEntry.description: Other properties are passed to the renderer as they are.

range.description: The window shown first, [start, end] in the units of mode. Default: everything.

mode.description: "relative": every cluster shows the same share of its range; "absolute": the same base pairs. Default: "relative".

min.description: The narrowest window, in the units of mode. Default: 1% of the slider.

update.description: Draw while the slider moves, or when it is let go. Default: "live".

height.description: Height of the slider in pixels. Default: 24.

overview.description: Whether the slider shows the genes of each cluster. Default: true.

color.description: One colour for the overview's genes in place of their group colours.

style.description: CSS styles of the slider's track.

handleStyle.description: CSS styles of the two handles.

clusters.description: The clusters this entry applies to, by name or 1-based position. Default: all clusters.

x.description: Position along the scale (text, symbol, promoter, terminator); an array draws one per position; an array draws one per value.

y.description: Vertical position, from 1 to 100 (text, symbol, promoter, terminator); an array draws one per value.

text.description: The text (text, textMarker, arc); an array draws one per value.

x1.description: Start position along the scale (line, arrow, textMarker, arc); an array draws one per value.

x2.description: End position along the scale (line, arrow, textMarker, arc); an array draws one per value.

y1.description: Start height, from 1 to 100 (line, arrow, textMarker, arc); an array draws one per value.

y2.description: End height, from 1 to 100 (line, arrow, textMarker, arc); an array draws one per value.

position.description: textMarker: the position along the scale; rectangle: corners [[x1, y1], [x2, y2]], or an array of them.

labelX.description: Horizontal offset of the text, in pixels (textMarker, arc); an array draws one per value.

labelY.description: Vertical offset of the text, in pixels (textMarker, arc); an array draws one per value.

showArrow.description: Whether the textMarker has an arrowhead.

arrowSize.description: Size of the arrowhead, in pixels (arrow, textMarker); an array draws one per value.

symbol.description: Symbol: circle, cross, diamond, square, star, triangle or wye.

size.description: Size of the symbol, in square pixels; an array draws one per value.

rotation.description: Rotation, in degrees (symbol, rectangle, promoter, terminator); an array draws one per value.

direction.description: Direction of a promoter or terminator.

scale.description: Size factor of a promoter or terminator; an array draws one per value.

midY.description: Height of the arc's middle, from 1 to 100; an array draws one per value.

strokeWidth.description: Line width of an arc, in pixels; an array draws one per value.

style.description: Style of the annotation (text, line, symbol, rectangle, promoter, terminator).

lineStyle.description: Style of the line (arrow, textMarker, arc).

annotationEntry.description: One annotation. The other properties are the options of its type, under their JavaScript names (x, y, text, ...).

idColumn.description: Column that identifies the gene to align on.

id.description: The value of idColumn of the gene to align on; one gene per cluster.

align.description: The side of the gene the clusters align on.
